delay_present_at_offer_outcomes.description: What happens when an offer is made despite a delay
delay_present_at_offer_outcomes.notes: In every recorded case (all involving a furnishing-cost or other unresolved delay), the offer was made anyway but the lead deferred the decision rather than accepting or explicitly rejecting on the call — the delay condition was never resolved before the offer's expiry in the transcript record.
